criteria.description: Provide native gh-style issue create/list/view/edit/comment/close/reopen commands operating on the same signed issues as hn issue, without invoking gh or GitHub.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Support documented familiar flags, filtering, explicit JSON field selection and nonzero failures; reject unsupported semantics explicitly.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Explicitly import one selected GitHub issue or all bounded repository issue pages, excluding pull requests.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Preserve original issue/comment IDs, URLs, author and timestamps as source claims. Imports use the native actor and preserve native-only information.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Discover stable source mappings, reject duplicates, preserve local edits and refuse competing remote/local changes; use guarded native mutations and retry-safe operations.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Export one explicitly selected native issue with supported fields, lifecycle and comments to the chosen GitHub repository; document unmappable fields.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Repeat/resume exports without blind creation retries; use durable checkpoints and complete bounded marker reconciliation, refusing ambiguous matches and outcomes.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Contact GitHub only from explicit transport commands; credentials are optional for public reads, required for writes, and never stored in signed issue data or diagnostics.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Build/test/use native and compatibility issue commands with GitHub transport completely excluded. Removing transport must not affect imported issues.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Publish exact command examples, supported compatibility subset, conflict/recovery behavior, bounds, attribution and offline-build instructions.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Keep transfer orchestration, source identities, checkpoints and issue/comment data independent of provider-specific DTOs. Expose explicit provider/project selection; GitHub is the first optional adapter.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Represent issues, projects and workflows as distinct migration resources and report implemented, mapping-required or unsupported resources before any write. Document extension contracts and the first delivery boundary; never claim arbitrary workflow equivalence.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Provide signed Git-backed discussion threads and independently revisioned replies, categories, open/closed state and accepted-answer revision references, with native CLI and explicit conflict handling.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Provide signed Git-backed planning projects with bounded typed fields/views and independently revisioned work items, typed targets and field values pinned to an exact project-schema revision.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Provide signed versioned native workflow definitions using existing pipeline/runner semantics, native CLI, explicit materialization and exact proposal-definition binding before governed run requests. Foreign definitions remain inert until mapped.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: New resources use verified signed actor histories and existing Git transport, strict bounded type-specific states, actor-pinned replay-safe writes, exact revision guards, visible concurrent heads and explicit resolution. No provider is needed for native operation.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Import/export supported GitHub discussion threads/replies, source attribution, categories, state and answer references through optional adapters, with explicit category/unsupported-semantics mapping and safe repeat/recovery.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Import/export supported GitHub Projects V2 definitions and items, remapping field/option/content identities and reporting unsupported field/layout/automation semantics before mutation. Board ownership/selectors are separate from repository selectors.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Import/export workflow definitions with exact source bytes/digests, explicit branch and execution/environment mappings, conservative write recovery and honest runnable/native-versus-foreign status. Never execute an imported definition implicitly.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.

criteria.description: Provider-neutral migration plans cover issues, projects, discussions and workflows, including dependency/reference mappings, supported/manual/unsupported semantics and explicit dry-run validation. Missing mappings or inaccessible dependencies prevent silent data loss.
criteria.notes: Source-bound independent integration review and concrete requirement trace; see evidence.
